fontMetadata.successorNotes: No glyph mappings are available for this font: the record exists so that a client substituting a modern face can still resolve a successor. The successor is unverified by measurement, as the legacy font is not installed here, though Finale Ash is.
fontMetadata.sizeNotes: Recorded from published information about the font rather than measured; the legacy font was not available locally.
fontMetadata.provenanceNotes: Compiled for this project; no conversion data for this font is distributed with Finale. No glyph mappings are recorded, so the file carries font-level facts only.
